changelog: Fixed ICC FTP server status and full 28-category pagination (40,000+ ICC titles including 4K UHD work automatically with green OK status).
Removed ICC FTP session setup section from both mobile and desktop apps.
Added VLC-style player touch sliders: left side swipe adjusts screen brightness, right side swipe adjusts volume with 0-200% audio boost.
Wired full Android back-button navigation across tabs, search, filters, detail, and player with double-back Quit/Cancel confirmation on Home.
